mapper.select: select count(rm.room_id) as total_count, sum(case when rm.book_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as no_book_count, sum(case when rm.book_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as has_book_count, sum(case when rm.book_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as has_into_count, sum(case when rm.book_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as has_repir_count, sum(case when rm.book_status = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as has_stop_count from hotel_room as rm
